user_approval.scope: MC-002 method freeze and bounded hidden runtime gate only; no full E7, six-arm or phase-two execution authorization

result_blind_freeze_recommendation.algorithm_gate_rule: if approved, use 3 regions x 3 predeclared representative sizes x 5 common seeds x 6 arms at B1600 before any full mechanism matrix
result_blind_freeze_recommendation.e7_rule: do not launch 2025 tasks directly; first run a result-hidden runtime pilot on one predeclared small/medium/large cell and all five arms
result_blind_freeze_recommendation.stop_rule: at 7 seeds, do not add more seeds to chase p-values; HALT and revisit independent-unit count, endpoint variance, or material threshold
result_blind_freeze_recommendation.top_up_rule: compute only within-map paired residual variance and runtime/failure rates; if the predeclared conservative MDE target is not met and within-seed variance remains material, add all maps uniformly to 7
result_blind_freeze_recommendation.within_cell_estimator: mean over three mutually exclusive maps; within each map mean over common seeds; each of 27 cells contributes one value
